verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Square serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) that declares itself 'consumable by both human developers and AI agents.' It includes explicit 'For agents' guidance and points to an llms-full.txt corpus, and individual docs pages render as raw markdown via the .md suffix (e.g., mcp.md, graphql.md, api-explorer.md). Missing for 10: the root docs.md index returns 404, and there is no independent community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
